{{nihongo|'''Kurohime Shrine (Sato‑miya, Takayanagi Town, Kashiwazaki City)'''|（上記神社里宮）黒姫神社（柏崎市高柳町）}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Echigo Province]].
